answer: Creating N sybils costs N full bonds plus sustained pulse upkeep, so honest peers verify stake-weighted pulses and slash duplicate identities. Each agent must stake a copper-denominated bond and broadcast a signed pulse every epoch; missed pulses decay the bond toward its nadir, while successful attestations replenish it. Attacker cost scales linearly with fake agents, making large-volume sybil farms economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0196's threat model.
